title: Chainsmoker Cat
description: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones’ concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

episodes_data.title: Chainsmoker Cat Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay rent and spends what little she has on cigarettes — until an urgent text from her sister Imoko sparks a far greater crisis.

episodes_data.title: Chainsmoker Cat Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Yani wants to continue her carefree life, but she receives a job offer as financial pressure builds. Will she commit to this opportunity or her freedom?
